reason: Adds a Settings page for viewing and restoring archived Harness sessions, including an option to restore and open a session; installation patches selected Harness bundles.

summaries.zh: 在 Harness 设置中集中查看已归档会话，并支持恢复会话或恢复后直接打开。
summaries.en: Adds a Harness Settings panel for viewing archived sessions and restoring them, with an option to open a session after restoration.

capabilities: Lists archived Harness sessions with titles, workspaces, and last activity times
Restores archived sessions and can open a restored session
Persists archived-session state across Harness restarts and synchronizes it across tabs
Modifies selected Harness host and client bundles during installation and supports rollback
